strategy.summary: Complete A-B-C twice for 3x Bonus, use the lit spinner before Base Bonus reaches 20,000, then complete D-E pairs to light and collect a 50,000 Snake Pit.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Two A-B-C completions raise end-of-ball bonus to its 3x maximum.

quickInfo.name: Lit Spinner Window
quickInfo.summary: The spinner scores 1,000 per spin while Base Bonus is between 10,000 and 19,000.

quickInfo.name: D-E Pair
quickInfo.summary: Collecting both inlane letters spots one number in the 1-2-3-4 set.

quickInfo.name: Snake Pit
quickInfo.summary: GOR completions raise the Snake Pit award, while a 1-2-3-4 completion sets it to 50,000.

steps.text: Use a controlled plunge toward B. Read the unlit A-B-C lanes because the game has no lane change.
Complete A-B-C once for 2x and again for 3x Bonus X.
modeNotes: Bonus X: A-B-C completions advance the end-of-ball multiplier to 3x; a drain spends and resets it.

steps.text: Build Base Bonus to 10,000. Rip the spinner before Base Bonus reaches 20,000.
modeNotes: Lit Spinner Window: The spinner scores 1,000 per spin from 10,000 through 19,000 Base Bonus, then stays unlit for the rest of the ball.

steps.text: Shatz pass through D and E only while the inlane geometry is safe. Each completed pair spots one 1-2-3-4 number.
modeNotes: D-E Pair: Collect both inlane letters to spend the pair and spot one number under the configured random or sequential setting.

steps.text: Complete all four numbers to set Snake Pit to 50,000 and advance Star Progress.
modeNotes: 1-2-3-4 Set: Completing all four lit numbers spends the set, sets Snake Pit to 50,000, and advances the star and target-Special track.

steps.text: Shoot Snake Pit for 50,000. Values of 20,000 or more reset the ladder after collection.
modeNotes: Snake Pit: GOR completions raise the award; the number set makes it 50,000. Collects at 10,000 or less remain repeatable, while larger collects reset it.

steps.text: Rebuild D-E and 1-2-3-4. Stop alley passing if the ball crosses toward an outlane.
Use GOR completions as the fallback Snake Pit build when the inlane pass is unsafe.
Protect up to 29,000 Base Bonus at 3x for an 87,000 drain collect.

fallback.title: GOR and repeatable Pit values
fallback.when: Use this when D-E alley passes threaten the outlanes.

steps.text: Stop cross-alley passes.
Shoot GOR from the right flipper.
Complete the bank to raise Snake Pit one step.
Collect 5,000 or 10,000 only when the magnet release is safe.
Continue GOR toward a larger Pit value and use the lit spinner before 20,000 Base Bonus.

alternatives.title: Repeatable 15,000 eject
alternatives.when: Use this only after the left-saucer kickout is proven safe.

steps.text: Complete GOR and GAR pairs until the Eject Ladder reaches 15,000.
Do not advance to Extra Ball unless that award is useful.
Shoot the eject saucer for 15,000.
Trap the kickout and repeat while the ladder remains at 15,000.

alternatives.title: GAR targets
alternatives.when: Use this when the GAR bank has safe rebounds.

steps.text: Complete GAR and read the newly lit feature.
Build bumper values under the installed Function 31 rule.
Use the 5,000 GAR targets when lit.
Ignore the outlane Special when it has no tournament value.
Complete A-B-C twice for 3x Bonus X.
Use the lit-spinner window for points and top-lane returns.
Complete D-E pairs to spot 1-2-3-4.
Complete the number set and collect a 50,000 Snake Pit.
Repeat the number set to advance Star Progress.
Protect up to 87,000 end-of-ball bonus.

techniques.name: Controlled B-lane plunge
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled plunge toward B for three Base Bonus advances and early A-B-C progress.

techniques.name: Lit-spinner rip
techniques.instruction: Shoot the spinner hard from the left flipper only during the 10,000 through 19,000 bonus window.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Shatz pass through D or E only after confirming the ball cannot continue into the outlane.

techniques.name: Eject trap and reshoot
techniques.instruction: Trap one saucer kickout before you use the repeatable 15,000 eject route.

cautions.issue: A hard D-E pass can continue through the inlane into the outlane.
cautions.response: Reduce flip power and stop when the ball reaches the top of the inlane.

cautions.issue: Drop and standup targets can reject toward a drain.
cautions.response: Use D-E or GOR when those lines return the ball more safely.

cautions.issue: The Snake Pit magnet release is copy-dependent.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready until the release path is known.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Functions 31–34 for GAR grouping, Eject Ladder memory, number spotting, Extra Ball, Special, and star-memory behavior.
Test the Snake Pit release, eject-saucer kickout, spinner return, both inlanes, and target-bank rebounds before choosing a repeat route.
Verify three-ball or five-ball play, tilt, and whether tournament awards are disabled or converted to points.
strategy.simpleOverview: Gorgar uses A-B-C for Bonus X and D-E pairs to spot 1-2-3-4 for the Snake Pit. Complete A-B-C twice for 3x, use the lit spinner before base bonus reaches 20,000, then complete D-E pairs and shoot Snake Pit at 50,000.
strategy.overview: Gorgar uses A-B-C for Bonus X and D-E pairs to spot 1-2-3-4 for the Snake Pit. Reach 3x, use the spinner during its valuable window, then make only controlled D-E passes until 1-2-3-4 is complete. Collect Snake Pit, rebuild the number set for Star Progress, and protect the multiplied base bonus from a tilt.
machineSetup: Confirm Functions 31–34 for GAR grouping, Eject Ladder memory, number spotting, Extra Ball, Special, and star-memory behavior.
Test the Snake Pit release, eject-saucer kickout, spinner return, both inlanes, and target-bank rebounds before choosing a repeat route.
Verify three-ball or five-ball play, tilt, and whether tournament awards are disabled or converted to points.
